notes: Two automated execution-risk notices fired on exec results during this build (one on the fresh-clone listing, one on the push output). No git command was run inside the flagged clone and nothing was copied from it; the entry was built in a fresh directory created by the builder (entry/) holding only files the builder wrote, and pushed to the remote created by the authorized repo-create command. The empty clone directory fast-csv-reader/ was left untouched. The coordinator should be aware of this routing.
